name: plain-vs-rag-pilot-v1
selection_rule: For each repository and each answerability (answerable, unanswerable) choose the question whose SHA-256 of '<seed>|<repository_id>|<answerability>|<question_id>' is smallest. Only question ids and the answerability flag are read. No historical answer, retrieval result, judge score or M10 outcome is used.
notes: Same resolved protocol, prompts, judge and rubric as the primary run.
Separate artifact namespace; runs carry scope=pilot; no historical reuse.
Not imported into the primary analysis; far too small for inference.
